# oxide_current_user_groups (Data Source)

Retrieve the groups to which the currently authenticated user belongs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oxide_current_user_groups" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name that identifies the group.
- `id` (String) Unique, immutable, system-controlled identifier of the group.
- `silo_id` (String) Unique, immutable, system-controlled identifier of the silo to which the group belongs.
- `time_created` (String) Timestamp of when the group was created.
- `time_modified` (String) Timestamp of when the group was last modified.
